predeclared_hypothesis: The accepted D02 traditional installed-LRU OPHOURS model stays at 300000 failures per million operating hours for both system and item.
A custom KM parameter advances at 60 KM per mission hour; equal 5000 failures per million KM rows on the system and installed item add a second 0.3 per-hour nominal exposure during mission operation.
The system and item have equal FRT in each OPID, so the installed item does not exceed its mother rate.
The installed native executable will import, export, convert and simulate the two-OPID traditional case without a conversion error.
native_acceptance_gates: All 21 populated source tables roundtrip with equal columns and rows.
The native converter produces a nonempty calculated model and no conversion error, with the report export complete.
The custom-operation report setting loads without fallback, and native SOACC contains positive KM exposure on a mission that actually operates.
The source and raw evidence hashes are sealed and an independent reviewer replays the claim set.
limits: A fixed-seed stochastic event count is not a measurement of the exact hazard sum.
